domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare and align operands
skills.definition: Rewrite fractions, mixed numbers, or whole numbers into equivalent subtraction-ready forms, including matching denominators and normalizing operand representations before subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: This preserves the natural preparation phase from the K=4 level. S01 and S02 both concern representational alignment before any subtraction is performed.

skills.name: Execute subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: Perform subtraction on aligned quantities, including subtracting whole and fractional parts and borrowing/regrouping one whole into fractional units when needed.
skills.merge_rationale: At a coarser level, S04 can be merged into S03 because regrouping is an extension of the subtraction execution phase and is prerequisite-linked to it: borrowing only occurs in the course of attempting subtraction. In the dossiers, these often appear as consecutive parts of one execution episode (e.g., FS07, FS10).

skills.name: Finalize and simplify answer
skills.definition: Express the computed result in simplest acceptable form, including reducing fractions and removing zero fractional parts.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final simplification remains a distinct end-stage operation even at coarse granularity. It is educationally meaningful to distinguish correct computation from failure to present the answer in simplest form.
